name: Auriga Fire
description: The Auriga Fire was the personal starship of smuggler Jet Nebula around a decade after the Treaty of Coruscant. From above it appeared almost perfectly triangular, with hyperdrives at the base; sensor arrays, shield generators, and comms at the upper point; and a cockpit slightly off-center in the middle, above the main holds. Its interior hallways were arranged in a "Y" shape. The ship also possessed a compact tractor beam generator in recessed hatch on its ventral side, as well as a crude interdictor.
